name: Youth Advisory Council
city: Hermosa Beach, Manhattan Beach and Redondo Beach, CA
what_you_do: Help peers find health resources. Speak up about stress, vaping, mental health and other teen issues. Help plan programs and make videos and flyers.
who_can_apply: You must be in grades 8 to 12 at a school in Hermosa Beach, Manhattan Beach or Redondo Beach.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You earn community service hours.
duration: One school year: eight council meetings and three community events
deadline_text: Last cycle: applications for the 2026-27 school year ran July 1, 2026 to Aug 2, 2026. Dates for next year are not posted as of Nov 3, 2026.
how_to_apply: When the next window comes, send the application with the Media Release, Volunteer Form and Ground Rules forms. Questions: cindy.carcamo@bchd.org.
notes: More than 50 students serve. You must finish a volunteer orientation. Tell staff early if you have a schedule conflict.
